scripts.label: Only playable move
scripts.text: This was the only move we found that kept the position playable. The other moves we checked were losing.

scripts.label: Sound sacrifice
scripts.text: The sacrifice holds up in the search even when it is accepted. Taking the offered material does not refute the idea in this line.

scripts.label: Abandoned defender
scripts.text: This move takes away a piece's only effective defender. The other side can capture that piece in the continuation.

scripts.label: Allowed checkmate
scripts.text: This move allows a forced checkmate. Follow the continuation to see why the defense can no longer hold.

scripts.label: Recovered after a mistake
scripts.text: After the earlier setback, this move restores a playable position. There is a way forward again.

scripts.label: Undefended piece
scripts.text: This leaves a piece undefended. That alone does not mean the piece can be won.

scripts.label: Missed a fork
scripts.text: The stronger continuation had a fork. This move misses the chance for one piece to attack several targets at once.

scripts.label: An unusual strong move
scripts.text: The human-move model treats this as an unusual choice, and the engine still finds it strong.
